none: PAS LON-F932D8: Early Medieval silver coin: sceat
contea di ritrovamento: Greater London (Inghilterra e Galles)

An Early Medieval silver coin: sceat, series T (type 9), date: c.715-20). Obverse: Diademed bust right with wreath ties behind, small cross in front of face. Obverse inscription (probable): LELT(T inverse). Reverse: 'Porcupine' left, the curved 'body' enclosing four lines. Reverse inscription: None. Die axis: 6.00. Dimensions: diameter: 12.21mm; weight: 1.02g
